original_test_intent: Load the NVIDIA driver with an approved UUID blacklist, verify only selected GPUs are excluded while allowed GPUs/fabric remain healthy, and demonstrate NVQual can run on an allowed target but cannot run on a blacklisted target.
original_method: Pin driver/fabricmanager/nvqual compatibility and prove NVreg_GpuBlacklist syntax/support; map every GPU UUID/BDF and select blacklist/allowed sets; preserve module/params/fabric/log baseline, drain jobs and prepare OOB rollback; operator approves service/module disruption; stop fabricmanager, unload/reload driver by reviewed procedure, verify parameter/sets, restart/validate fabric; run bounded NVQual allowed-target then non-destructive explicit blacklisted-target refusal; restore original module state and full health.
manual_activity: Driver/fabric owner selects UUIDs and validates parameter/module/nvqual recovery; operator authorizes root service/module changes and owns OOB; agent may execute bounded approved sequence.
required_inputs: Driver version and documented NVreg_GpuBlacklist UUID syntax/support
Complete GPU UUID/BDF/topology map with blacklist and allowed sets
Reviewed rmmod_driver artifact/hash and exact unload/reload/rollback behavior
Fabricmanager/driver/NVSwitch compatibility and service readiness oracle
Pinned NVQual build/config and explicit target/refusal semantics
Maintenance/job drain, console/OOB and original-state restore approval
safety_requirements: Never unload driver or stop fabricmanager without drained jobs and OOB
Do not infer UUID syntax or choose targets
Run only explicit allowed and blacklisted probes; no unrestricted stress
Stop on module/fabric/link/GPU/host error and restore only by approved plan; no auto-retry
agent_execution_scope: Capture baseline and perform approved service/module sequence
Collect allowed-pass and blacklisted-refusal plus fabric health
Coordinate restore and report without verdict
engineer_actions: Resolve stress-target ambiguity and approve IDs/oracle/sequence

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: nvidia-smi -L alone cannot prove module parameter, allowed-set health or NVQual refusal, and credentialed SSH is unsafe.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: After approved reload, verify params and exact GPU sets, run NVQual on one explicit allowed target, then perform the vendor-supported non-destructive blacklisted-target selection expecting defined refusal/absence; restore original module state.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: fabricmanager stop/start, UUID blacklist, module reload, nvidia-smi -B and NVQual exclusion remain; ambiguous target is not guessed.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use a transactional before/blacklisted/restored matrix for module parameters, fabric service, GPU UUID/BDF visibility and NVQual target outcome.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Separates allowed-GPU functional proof from blacklisted-GPU refusal and makes full restoration part of acceptance.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A missing GPU in nvidia-smi does not by itself prove safe blacklist behavior or preserved remaining fabric.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Module unload affects all GPUs and an unsupported parameter can leave no driver/fabric; OOB recovery is mandatory.

project_override_considerations: Driver owner defines supported blacklist syntax and whether a blacklisted target should be absent, rejected by selector, or return a specific NVQual code without executing stress.
expected_evidence: Reviewed script hash plus unload/reload/service logs and params
Pre/blacklisted/restored lspci, nvidia-smi -q/-B and fabric/link health
NVQual build/config, explicit allowed result and blacklisted refusal code/log
dmesg/XID/NVLink/BMC/SEL deltas, restore/recovery and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Procedure's final 'run stress ... without black list' does not specify allowed versus blacklisted target, while Criteria specifically requires blacklisted GPUs cannot run NVQual.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Static review is complete; execution awaits driver/nvqual semantics, selected IDs and approvals.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Compatibility row287 Wistron-NV GPU-00280-V002: define exact blacklist and allowed GPU UUID/BDF sets, supported NVreg_GpuBlacklist syntax, reviewed rmmod_driver/fabricmanager sequence, and whether final NVQual requires allowed-target PASS plus blacklisted-target absence/refusal with exact code; approve full module/fabric rollback/OOB recovery.

review_improvement: Makes blacklist selection, permitted workload, refusal semantics and full module/fabric restoration independently observable.
independent_technical_reasoning: PCI enumeration may still show a blacklisted GPU even when the NVIDIA module does not bind it, so lspci and nvidia-smi answer different questions. Stopping fabricmanager and unloading the driver disrupts every GPU, not only the selected UUIDs. An unrestricted stress could accidentally run allowed devices and say nothing about exclusion; explicit target selection and refusal semantics are required before restoring the known-good module state.
